formats.key: Permit(address owner,address spender,uint256 value,uint256 nonce,uint256 deadline)
effects: Sets the spender's allowance over the owner's stETH to exactly `value` stETH. This replaces any earlier allowance and does not add to it (StETH._approve: allowances[_owner][_spender] = _amount).
Uses up the owner's current permit nonce, so any other unused permit signed with that nonce stops working (StETHPermit._useNonce).
Anyone can submit the signature up to `deadline`. After that it is rejected (require(block.timestamp <= _deadline)).
A value of type(uint256).max gives an allowance that never goes down when spent (StETH._spendAllowance, INFINITE_ALLOWANCE).
formats.shown: The intent is "Authorize spending of tokens". The fields show the spender address (raw), the maximum amount in stETH ("Unlimited" at 2^255 or more), the valid-until date and the owner. The nonce is hidden.

findings.title: The stETH Permit format has no test case, so no rendering of the amount or the Unlimited message is checked.
findings.evidence: FORMATS.md: "cases: 0 (no tx)" for Permit(address owner,address spender,uint256 value,uint256 nonce,uint256 deadline). The descriptor has a threshold of 0x8000…0000 with the message "Unlimited" on `value`. No case exercises it.
findings.fix: Add two EIP-712 test cases: one with a finite stETH value and one with value = 2^256-1. The second one must render "Unlimited".
